title: Memory and precision in noiseless Gaussian regression
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。
status: AI 产生的研究手稿；收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
abstractEnglish: For every fixed A > 0, a learner that retains at most $`Ad^2`$ bits between fresh exact Gaussian linear measurements needs $`\Omega_A(d\log(1/\epsilon))`$ measurements to estimate a uniformly random unit vector to angular error at most ϵ, for any $`0\lt \epsilon\le 1/10`$, with probability at least 2/3. The constant is absolute for $`o(d^2)`$ memory.
